chapter.verse: Tua ciangin vanmi in crystal suangmanpha bangin a te kelkel nuntakna tui luanna gun hong lak hi. Pasian leh Tuuno' kumpi-tokhom pan a phulkhia hi a,
khuapi sung lamzikpi a laizang dungah luang hi. Gun a langkhat tuakah gah nam sawmlenih a nei nuntakna singkungte om a, kha simin gah hi. Tua singkung a tehte pen minamte damsakna' ading ahi hi.
Samsiat ngah cih bang om nawnlo ding a, khuapi sungah Pasian leh Tuuno' tokhom bek omin ama' silate in amah bia ding uh hi.
Amaute in ama' maitang mukha ding uh a, a tal tung uhah ama' min tuang ding hi.
Zan om nawnlo ding a, amaute pen meivak taang leh ni vangtaang kisam lo ding uh hi. A hang pen Topa Pasian amau' khuavak hiding a, a tawntung a tawntungin amau teng a uk hiding uh hi.

Tua ciangin tua vanmi in hih bangin hong gen hi, “Hih thute muantaakin thumaan ahi hi. Kamsangte' khate ii Pasian ahi Topa in zong a sawt lo-a hong piang hamtang ding thute a silate' tungah a lak dingin ama' vanmite sawlkhia khin hi.”
“Tua hi a, en in, kei kong pai pah ding hi. Hih laibu sunga kamsanna thute a zui mi thuphangah ahi hi.”
Keimah John pen hih thute a zapa a mupa ka hi hi. Hihte ka zak ka muh ciangin kei' tunga hong lak vanmi a bia dingin a khe-phung ah ka boksuk hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “Tuaci kei in! Kei pen nang leh na sanggam kamsangte ahi zongin, hih laibu sunga thute a zui mite ahi zongin, note' silapih khat ka hi lel hi. Pasian bia in,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “A hun nai ta ahih manin hih laibu sunga kamsanna thute gip tawh belhcip kei in.
A siattatte siattat lai phot uh hen; a thanghuaite thanghuai lai phot uh hen; a diktatte diktat lai phot uh hen; a siangthote siangtho lai phot uh hen,” hong ci hi.
“En in, kei kong pai pah ding a, mi kim amau' sepkhiat bangin ka ditkik nadingin thaman kong keng ding hi.
Kei pen Alpha leh Omega, a masabel leh a nunungbel, a kipatna leh a tawpna, ka hi hi.”
A puantual a sawpsiangte thuphangah ahi hi. Tua pen nuntakna singkung zuat theihna thu ngahin kulh kongvang pan khuapi sung a lut theih nading uh ahi hi.
A pualam-a omte ahihleh uite-a kipan aitawite, nulepa tatkhialhna a bawlte, tualthatte, milim biate leh zuau thu nuamsa-in a zang teng khempeuh ahi uh hi.
“Keimah Jesu in pawlpite' adingin hih thute nang' kiangah teci hong pang dingin ka vanmi ka sawlkhia khin hi. Kei pen David' bulsela leh suanlekhak, zingsol aksi taang ka hi hi.”
Kha leh Mo Nungak in, “Hong pai in,” ci uh hi. Hih a za peuhmah in, “Hong pai in,” ci ta hen. A dangtak mi hong pai henla, a deih mi in nuntakna tui a khawnkhongin la ta hen.
Hih laibu sunga kiguang kamsanna thute a za khempeuh' tungah teci kong pang hi: Hih thute a behlap khatpeuh a om leh Pasian in tua mi' tungah hih laibu sunga kigen gimpinate behlap ding a,
hih kamsanna laibu' sunga thute a hemkhia a om leh Pasian in tua nuntakna singkung leh khuapi siangtho sunga tua mi' ngah sehtan lakkhiatsak ding hi.
Hih thute teci a pang mipa in, “Kei kong pai pah takpi ding hi,” ci hi. Amen. Topa Jesu aw, hong pai ta in!
Topa Jesu' hehpihna in mi siangtho khempeuh hong ompih ta hen. Amen.
